title: Subscription is keeping me away from this game...

posts.cooked:
I am not against subscriptions and I have bought those and more in the past, but I play when I am in the mood for a game, not out of habit, addiction or even some kind of misguided obligation.

The problem is, my favorite ships are Omega, and I am not clairvoyant. Sometimes I pick up a game for a day and then put it down again for a few days, weeks or months, and sometimes I stick with it for months.
But I never know when that may be, so paying a total of $20 or $30 for what may be just 1 or 2 days of gameplay is just ridiculous...

Okay so don't buy a month of premium at a time?

EVE's online store offers a 3-day "weekend" pack for $3.75, and you can buy Omega on Steam in 7-day increments:

https://store.eveonline.com/product/weekend-fleet-pack/verm-6203
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125050/EVE_Online_7_Days_Omega_time/

If you have amazon prime or netflix you are just a big hipocrite.

Pay for your services
Why the big effort on creating such worthless posts? Got no other games?

Same with every MMO on the market that run a subscription, the more you get, the less it costs.

The silver lining with Eve I guess is that, you're always training skills (so long as you set a training queue), so even when you're not online you still make progress into being able to do more things. I subbed both my accounts until January 2027, but I didn't log in much the last month maybe to reset the PI, there will likely be other months this year that i won't be playing Eve but some other game, characters still train skills though. The SP also has a value. which can be extracted and sold to recoup some of the cost, I don't think you make a whole plex worth of SP per month of character training, but it probably is around 1/3rd to 1/2 half a plex. (more if using implants or accelerators)

If you want to play long term then you're going to be subbed for years. Like, once you're able to fly the ships that require omega, you're not going to want to play as an alpha again.

Subscription keeps me away as well. I played EVE a lot ...years ago, payed subscription for a while until I figured out how to farm PLEX ingame. But at the point where I would reduce my game time neither - subsription nor gathering PLEX via ingame tasks justified the afford. Subcription makes it a lot more difficult dragging your friends into your game. Everytime I took a look into EVE again I was watching a hangar full of ships that I owned and that I was able to fly but I'm not allowed to use them anymore until I pay. Does not feel like they want me back. Other games make a lot more afford to get me back. BDO gives me returners boni. WOT premium and even if I decide to watch for a while I can play anything grinded in the past. Albion is the EVE alternative in pretty much every way without subscription ... and won every time I was in mood to play something like that (0.0 = BZ, Low-Sec = RZ, WH = Paths. market player driven, ganking almost same... except no bubbles - but lots better FW).
$200+ a year for a video game you have to literally work in is funny to me. It's even funnier that you see the same shills defending it.
who cares? you are just announcing to the world you arent gonna play a game. Who are you and why should anyone give a ♥♥♥♥?
